content.text: I've completed my review. Let me record the finding.

input.quote: (a) During the term of this Agreement, Company agrees to compensate Contractor as set forth in each Statement of Work. Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation obligation burdens Clear Capital anywhere in the Agreement. Section 3 (Contractor's Compensation) sets pricing purely by reference to each Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis, with the only pricing-adjustment right running the other way (p0014: "Contractor reserves the right to change rates with 30 days notice to Company"). Targeted searches for MFN formulations ("no less favorable", "most favored/favoured", best/lowest price, matching third-party terms, preferential or same terms, other customers/clients) returned no MFN language. The single "other clients" reference (p0019) is a non-exclusivity acknowledgement permitting RadialSpark to serve other clients — it imposes no obligation on us to extend RadialSpark terms given to third parties, and it does not require us to match any third-party offer. Consistent with the rule's direction analysis, there is no obligation on Customer to flag, so the preferred position ("No MFN obligation on Customer") is met and no redline is warranted. Note the Agreement also contains no MFN in our favour, but the playbook treats a Customer-favourable MFN as merely welcome rather than required, so its absence is not a deviation.
